info.name: Lambda Zero-trust PoC
info.description:
CRUD examples for the Lambda Zero-trust PoC REST API (API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB, protected by a Cognito User Pool authorizer).

Set `baseUrl` to the deployed API base URL and `token` to an Authorization value:

- **Local (Floci)**: `baseUrl = http://localhost:4566/restapis/<api_id>/dev/_user_request_` (get `<api_id>` via `terraform output -raw api_id`); any token value works, e.g. `test`.
- **Real AWS**: `baseUrl = <api_url>` (get via `terraform output -raw api_url`, e.g. `https://<api-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com/dev`); set `token` to a Cognito ID token (mint one with `aws cognito-idp initiate-auth --client-id <client> --auth-flow USER_PASSWORD_AUTH --auth-parameters USERNAME=...,PASSWORD=...` and use the `AuthenticationResult.IdToken`).

Create an item first, then copy its `id` into the `itemId` variable.

See docs/api-examples.md for curl equivalents.

request.description:
POST /items — create an item. Returns 201 with the stored record (including the generated `id`, `PK`/`SK` partition keys, and timestamps). Copy the returned `id` into the `itemId` collection variable for the Get/Update/Delete requests.

Accepted fields: `name` (required, 1-255 chars), `description` (optional, <=1024), `price` (optional, >=0).
GET /items — list all items. Returns 200 with `{"items": [...], "count": n}` (empty table: `{"items": [], "count": 0}`).
GET /items/{id} — get a single item. Returns 200 with the item record, or 404 with `{"message": "Item not found: <id>"}`.

PUT /items/{id} — partial update of an item. All fields optional (`name`, `description`, `price`). Returns 200 with the updated record (or the unchanged record for an empty body), or 404 if the item does not exist.
DELETE /items/{id} — delete an item. Returns 204 with an empty body, or 404 if the item does not exist.
